# Starter recipes (version 0.1.0)

These are the prompts of our mini test, as data. They are a baseline, not tuned prompts. The task shape is: Image 1 is the product photo, Image 2 is a pose reference photo (a person posing with some other product or outfit), and the engine swaps the product.

## How a prompt is assembled

1. The **header**, with `{verb}` set to `wear` or `hold`.
2. For the generic variant `v0`, the **v0 tail**. For `v1`, the **v1 lead**, then one **rule** per risk tag the product has (in the order below), then the **always** rule.
3. For products that carry text, an optional second pass with the **repair** prompt on the first result.

## Header

> Photorealistic e-commerce catalog photo edit. Image 1 is the PRODUCT photo. It may also show a hand, a mannequin, a background or props: ignore all of that and use only the product itself. Image 2 is the POSE REFERENCE photo: it shows a person posing with a different product or outfit. Recreate Image 2 (the same person, pose, framing, camera angle, background, lighting and mood), but make the person {verb} the exact product from Image 1 instead of the product or outfit in Image 2.

## v0 tail

> Keep the product's shape, color, material and every detail unchanged. No watermark.

## v1 lead

> Keep the product's shape, color, material and every detail unchanged. Follow these rules:

## Rules by risk tag

| Tag | Use it when | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | words, letters, numbers or a logo are printed on the product | TEXT AND LOGOS (highest priority): every word, letter, number and logo printed on the product must be reproduced exactly as in Image 1: same characters, same font style, same colors, same position and same relative size. Do not invent, translate, rearrange, blur or add any text. If some text is too small to read in Image 1, render it as the same tiny unreadable marks instead of inventing words. The side of the product that carries the text must face the camera, fully visible, in focus and not covered by fingers. |
| `glass` | glass or other transparent material | GLASS: keep the glass transparent or translucent with the same color, thickness, relief pattern and highlights as in Image 1; keep any stopper, cap or liquid exactly as in Image 1. |
| `metal` | polished or matte metal (jewelry, tins, caps) | METAL: keep the same metal color and finish (polished or matte) with realistic reflections; do not change the shape of chains, links, pendants, settings or ornaments. |
| `gem` | gemstones | GEMSTONES: keep the same stone color, cut and number of stones, and the same setting. |
| `lace` | lace or embroidery | LACE: keep the exact lace or embroidery pattern, its scale and its see-through areas; do not simplify the lace into a plain fabric or change the pattern. |
| `black` | a deep black product, where detail is easy to lose | BLACK: keep the garment as deep black without lifting it to gray; keep the visible pleats, seams and fabric texture. |
| `pattern` | a printed or woven pattern | PRINT: keep the printed pattern, its colors and its scale exactly as in Image 1; do not replace it with a different pattern. |
| `multi` | more than one piece (a set, a bottle and its stopper, tubes and a card) | PARTS: show every part of the product that Image 1 shows (for example a bottle and its stopper, or two tubes and their card) and no extra parts. |
| `hand` | the person holds the product in a hand | HANDS: fingers wrap naturally around the product and never pass through it; each hand has exactly five fingers; keep natural contact shadows. |
| `worn_hand` | the product is worn on a finger | RING: the ring sits on a finger in the correct place and at its real size; the finger and hand look natural. |
| `person_in_photo` | the product photo itself shows a hand, a mannequin or a person that must not be copied | DO NOT COPY: do not copy any hand, mannequin, display stand, background or prop from Image 1 into the result. |

## Always

> SIZE: keep the product's real-world size relative to the person's body; do not enlarge or shrink it. No other text, logo, watermark or caption anywhere in the image.

## Repair (second pass for text)

> Image 1 is the real product photo. Image 2 is a generated photo of a person with that product. Edit Image 2 so that the printed text and logos on the product are identical to Image 1: same characters, font style, color, position and relative size. Change nothing else: keep the person, pose, framing, background, lighting, and the product's shape and material exactly as they are in Image 2. Do not add any other text.

## Starting points by sub-category

| Sub-category | Verb | Tags to start from |
|---|---|---|
| Tops | wearing | none |
| Outerwear | wearing | none |
| Dresses and skirts | wearing | none |
| Pants | wearing | none |
| Necklaces | wearing | metal |
| Earrings | wearing | metal |
| Rings | wearing | metal, worn_hand |
| Bracelets | wearing | metal |
| Lipstick | holding | hand |
| Base and skincare | holding | hand, text |
| Eyeshadow palettes | holding | hand, text, multi |

## What is not a prompt rule

- Products with small print: render at 2K or higher. In our mini test 1K gave unreadable small print in 8 of 8 photos and 2K in 0 of 4 (preliminary, see docs/mini-test.md).
- Fingers over a label, and a hem that follows the pose reference instead of the product, are fixed by choosing the pose, not by rewording.
